certification.name: EXIN Privacy & Data Protection Professional
certification.description: Advanced-level GDPR certification on data protection policies, the roles of controller, processor and DPO, impact assessments and breach response. Requires accredited training with practical assignments and a two-hour exam of 40 multiple-choice questions with a 65% pass mark.
certification.currency_note: Price is calculated per country on the EXIN site; accredited training with practical assignments is mandatory
